notes.title: Small distribution update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are very happy to finally get full control of the publishing rights of Flat Heroes. After a lot of discussing we have decided to bring the price of our game on par with other platforms (9.99$). We think that the new price will still be very fair for the scope of Flat Heroes and it will give us a tiny bit more room to work on projects to come.

The adjusted price will come into effect earliest August 1st 2019. We wanted to give you a quick shout about this upfront so you still have the chance to buy the game at the current price if you want to.

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Small Update: Launch Options!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After reading some feedback from the community, we made a small update to add a few launch options (to enable them go to Steam, right click on Flat Heroes > "Properties" > "Set Launch Options", and write the commands you want to use, without the ' ):

'-disableGeometryShaders' : use it to go back to the more "flat" version, we prefer the new and improved style, but we won't judge you if you want the old one back :) - [NOTE: this is automatically enabled on low-end PCs]

'-show-screen-selector' : to see the launcher that lets you change the resolution and Graphics Quality

'-mouseButtonSupport' : a few users wanted the old mouse+keyboard control (where you attacked with the mouse), use this if you want the old controls back.

If there are any issues, you can find us in the forums! :)

notes.title: New update v0.48 is live!!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today there's a new Flat Heroes update (v0.48)!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/0004e90055da9d933e06ed78f9a920e30d8f6086.gif

We've been working on the difficulty curve to make it a bit more smooth, and this update also adds a new world and brings some new enemies to the waves mode. It's a great opportunity to revisit the adventure again!

We also updated the player's movement set to add some more depth and give players more options in each situation, so there are new and more exciting ways to beat some levels now! And we reworked the charging and shooting mechanics for the versus modes, which should make it more viable to use in combats.

And you may also find lots of small changes that we've been doing to polish the game further :)

Here are the update notes:

 New Final Boss! Currently on world 6, let us know what you think!
 New enemy inspired by some retro game (guess which one!), but of course a bit more intense 
 New enemy based on beehives... but of course more intense?
 Added new levels, reaching 7 levels now!
 New and reworked level progression, with a 200% better difficulty curve*
 New charge-shooting mechanic for versus battles: now 200% more trepidant
 New secret and deeper player movements: dash dash dash!
 New juicy animations
 Automatic quality adjustment, 60 fps is a right, not a privilege
 Extra gamefeel bits all around the game, including:
        > updated initial countdown
        > walls that kill should be a bit more clear now
        > on runner it should be more when the runner changes and who is the new one
	> new end of match effect on some versus modes
 Optimizations and bug fixes here and there

* based on internal studies and magic spells.

If you find any issue or have any suggestion feel free to join us on the game's Steam discussions.
Still, this is not the big update we're going to make soon-ish, we're still working on that one!

Oh, and Flat Heroes has been recently nominated to the SXSW Gamer's Voice awards in Texas! :D
Check out the nominees! 

Enjoy!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/852d0b87f647544388c0bcc494f6645ea6a22e9a.gif


PS: sorry for those who were doing a let's play series, we had to reorder and add many levels.
PS2: ICYMI the game is now cheaper during Early Access, take a look at the previous announcement for more details!

notes.title: New patch v0.46 is live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/e037995ea37e4fc8467e10f23ac261eee3f398bd.gif

Hi everyone!

In this update we have focused on continuing to polish small details to make the game feel better, i.e. now a subtle slow-mo happens if the last enemy of a wave is killed by a player, adding up a bit of excitement when you complete a hard level! 

We also added our first boss intro! The World 5 Boss now has an intro the first time you encounter it, intros for the rest of the bosses will be added on future updates.

Another change introduced is a gentle push to player's attack, player attacks will now push away nearby players a little bit in cooperative modes. This is to avoid "turtle formations" (multiple players really close to each other attacking non-stop). We've seen some players use this strategy on advanced levels and they don't learn what they must learn in order to progress on further levels. It's also in preparation to the addition of teams, where this strategy would lead to really boring matches. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/129fae87908b12706a90055268f8e27043d26f90.gif

 Patch notes  

- Player's attack now gently pushes surrounding players if they are too close, to avoid turtle formations
- Added slow-mo on the last enemy of waves levels if that enemy is killed by a player
- World 5 Boss now has an intro, we'll be adding other boss intros on future updates
- World 5 Boss now has some extra screen-shakes and gamepad rumbles!
- Added Parallel Circles logo
- Fixed issue where the pick-up could not be attacked during the first half a second in catch
- On catch players' rotation is also reset at the end of each mini-round to avoid some weird jumps
- Small fix on button text
- Minor optimizations on memory usage
- Added more vibration events

notes.title: New update with 2 new intense levels, v0.45 is live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We had a really busy week with EGX and some other secret stuff but here's the new update!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/f6e6d503412433844c800ffff3366dbbf5bd93d1.gif

In this update you'll find a couple of new levels and some bug fixes. We've also changed 6.13 since we've seen some players really struggling with it, but no worries it will probably reappear on world 7 or 8!

Patch notes:
- Updated 6.8 to make sure players understand what it's trying to teach
- Added a new level on world 6 (6.14) and replaced 6.13 for an easier level
- Fixed issues with charging/bullets on Battle and Zones where some players could not get them
- Updated speedrun times of all 6 worlds to make them a bit easier, especially on lower tiers
- Updated world 5 boss(5.15) bullets to avoid exploits when there are many players

For any thoughts, comments or ideas you'll find us on the discussion boards! :)

notes.title: Flat Heroes Release Date announced (Early Access, September 8)
notes.notes:
We're really excited to announce the release date of Flat Heroes on Steam!
And we've got a new trailer to announce the Early Access launch!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgdtKS6GWTE

Flat Heroes will be available in Early Access on Steam on September 8th, 2016 for Windows, Mac and Linux! That's next week!!

From launch the game will include a solo/co-op mode (1-4 players) with around 90 levels and 6 final bosses, and 4 competitive modes for up to 4 players that will also include bots to play against.

We have lots of ideas we'd like to implement, but we want to make sure we're going to the right direction while allowing players to shape the game.
So during Early Access we plan to work with the community and let you choose the kind of content you would like to see in the game (being solo player modes, more co-op modes/levels, more competitive modes, or who knows!) to make Flat Heroes an even bigger and better experience for everyone!

Stay tuned!
